Advanced models also include lamp failure detection, enhancing both safety and reliability. Multi-timers These timers are versatile and can be used across a wide range of vehicle systems, controlling the activation of electrical devices for a predetermined duration. They are essential for managing tasks like automatic lighting, power shutoff, and other auxiliary functions, contributing to both convenience and energy efficiency. WIWA Timers WIWA timers control the operation of windshield wipers and washers, ensuring that wipers run for a specific period or at regular intervals. This is particularly useful in maintaining visibility in various weather conditions, providing drivers with hands-free control of the wiper system.
